task.title: To insert the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in

step.cmd: Open and sign in to Microsoft Word.
Select the Insert tab and click My Add-ins.
In the Admin Managed tab, select the X-Author Contracts Advanced add-in. If you can't see the add-in, click Refresh.

postreq.p: In the Home tab of Microsoft Word, you can see the X-Author Contracts ribbon.
